  FROM cr_pack
),
packmap AS (
  SELECT id AS k, id AS pid FROM cr_pack
  UNION
  SELECT pack_number AS k, id AS pid FROM cr_pack WHERE pack_number IS NOT NULL
),
membership AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dm.doc AS doc, pm.pid AS pid
  FROM (SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack UNION SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member) x
  JOIN docmap dm ON dm.k = x.cr
  JOIN packmap pm ON pm.k = x.pack_id
),
modifies AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dm.doc AS doc, x.section_id AS sid
  FROM (SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section
        UNION SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by) x
  JOIN docmap dm ON dm.k = x.cr
),

  SELECT id AS doc, COALESCE(number, id) AS dnum, CAST(ltrim(upper(trim(target_release)), 'RELASEV-_ .#') AS INTEGER) AS rel
  FROM document
),
secn AS (
  SELECT id AS sid, spec, clause, CAST(ltrim(upper(trim(release)), 'RELASEV-_ .#') AS INTEGER) AS rel
  FROM section
),
qualdisp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dm.doc AS doc, di.code AS code, COALESCE(m.label, m.id) AS wg_meeting
  FROM disposition di
  JOIN docmap dm ON dm.k = di.target
  JOIN resolution r ON r.id = di.resolution_id
  JOIN meeting m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
  WHERE replace(replace(replace(lower(COALESCE(di.evidence_status,'')),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') LIKE '%source%' AND replace(replace(replace(lower(COALESCE(di.evidence_status,'')),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') LIKE '%verified%' AND replace(replace(replace(lower(COALESCE(di.evidence_status,'')),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') NOT LIKE '%unverif%' AND replace(replace(replace(lower(COALESCE(di.evidence_status,'')),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') NOT LIKE 'not%' AND replace(replace(replace(lower(COALESCE(di.evidence_status,'')),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') NOT LIKE '%notverif%' AND replace(replace(replace(lower(COALESCE(di.evidence_status,'')),'-',''),'_',''),' ','') NOT LIKE '%fail%'

  SELECT pid, tn FROM packs WHERE pnum = 'RP-250620' OR pid = 'RP-250620'

  JOIN membership mb ON mb.pid = a.pid
